item.title: Morgan Stanley to axe 2,500 jobs despite record revenues
item.description: Morgan Stanley plans to cut 2,500 jobs—around 3% of its workforce—despite reporting record revenues of $70.6bn, amid growing debate over AI’s impact on white-collar employment. Read more: Morgan Stanley to axe 2,500 jobs despite record revenues

item.title: Airlines hit by jet fuel surge as Iran conflict disrupts supply
item.description: Airlines face soaring fuel costs as jet fuel prices hit a three-and-a-half-year high following disruption in the Middle East, with European carriers warning profits could be squeezed despite hedging strategies. Read more: Airlines hit by jet fuel surge as Iran conflict disrupts supply

item.title: US likely to introduce 15% global tariff as Trump administration revives trade strategy
item.description: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says a 15% global tariff is likely this week as the Trump administration moves to restore trade levies after the Supreme Court struck down earlier tariffs. Read more: US likely to introduce 15% global tariff as Trump administration revives trade strategy

item.title: AI bias risks locking women out of tech-driven economic growth, MPs warn
item.description: New research from the Women and Work APPG warns AI systems risk reinforcing gender inequality in recruitment, promotion and pay unless women are better represented in technology development and governance. Read more: AI bias risks locking women out of tech-driven economic growth, MPs warn

item.title: Reflo launches £2.5m crowdfunding round inviting public to invest alongside Harry Kane
item.description: Sustainable sportswear brand Reflo has launched a £2.5m Crowdcube fundraising round, allowing the public to invest alongside England captain Harry Kane as the company accelerates global expansion. Read more: Reflo launches £2.5m crowdfunding round inviting public to invest alongside Harry Kane

item.title: Silverflow raises $40m Series B funding as cloud-native payments platform nears one billion transactions annually
item.description: Cloud-native payments platform Silverflow has secured $40m in Series B funding led by Picus Capital as it approaches one billion transactions annually and accelerates global expansion. Read more: Silverflow raises $40m Series B funding as cloud-native payments platform nears one billion transactions annually

item.title: Net-a-Porter workers ballot for strike action over London Living Wage dispute
item.description: More than 100 Net-a-Porter warehouse workers in London are voting on strike action after the luxury retailer was accused of breaking a pledge to pay the London Living Wage. Read more: Net-a-Porter workers ballot for strike action over London Living Wage dispute

item.title: Judicial review challenge launched over Home Office £40,000 voluntary departure payment scheme
item.description: A legal challenge has been initiated against the UK government over a pilot scheme reportedly offering payments of up to £40,000 to certain failed asylum seekers who voluntarily leave the country. Read more: Judicial review challenge launched over Home Office £40,000 voluntary departure payment scheme

item.title: Glasgow opens new Health Innovation Hub to accelerate life sciences innovation
item.description: The new Health Innovation Hub in Glasgow has officially opened, creating a major life sciences facility supporting precision medicine, digital health innovation and clinical research. Read more: Glasgow opens new Health Innovation Hub to accelerate life sciences innovation

item.title: Frasers Group builds 6% stake in struggling Puma
item.description: Mike Ashley’s Frasers Group has acquired a 5.77% stake in Puma, becoming the brand’s second-largest shareholder as the German sportswear giant battles losses and declining sales. Read more: Frasers Group builds 6% stake in struggling Puma
